The Secrets of Every Night, A Lonely Boy Wished He Could Stop Time.

One Day, His Wish Came True.

He Could Freeze Everything Around Him… The Rain, The Wind, Even People.

At First, He Felt Like A God.

He Used His Power To Win Fights, Avoid Pain, And Escape Every Problem.

But Slowly, He Noticed Something Terrifying.

Every Time He Stopped Time, Someone He Loved Forgot A Memory Of Him.

First, His Best Friend Forgot Their Childhood.

Then, His Mother Forgot His Name.

Desperate, He Stopped Time One Final Time And Whispered…

“I Don'T Need A World That Stops For Me. I Just Want A World Where I Can Stay With You.”

He Let Time Flow Again.

And For The First Time In His Life…

He Chose To Grow Older Instead Of Living Forever.
topic:
Every night, a lonely boy wished he could stop time.

One day, his wish came true.

He could freeze everything around him… the rain, the wind, even people.

At first, he felt like a god.

He used his power to win fights, avoid pain, and escape every problem.

But slowly, he noticed something terrifying.

Every time he stopped time, someone he loved forgot a memory of him.

First, his best friend forgot their childhood.

Then, his mother forgot his name.

Desperate, he stopped time one final time and whispered…

“I don't need a world that stops for me. I just want a world where I can stay with you.”

He let time flow again.

And for the first time in his life…

He chose to grow older instead of living forever.
